instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to enable format on save for all files.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save feature in VS Code. Similar complexity to original task but modifies editor behavior settings. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify editor.formatOnSave is set to true.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable format on save
Getter extracts the correct state: VS Code settings.json file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric check_json_settings correctly checks for editor.formatOnSave: true in the settings
Expected value is semantically correct - editor.formatOnSave: true is the exact VS Code setting needed
Complete coverage - instruction has single requirement and evaluator checks it
State is accessible without postconfig - settings persist to disk automatically when modified in VS Code
No logical issues with data flow: getter retrieves file -> metric parses JSON -> checks for correct key-value pair

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
